definitions.explanation: The first snowfall of the winter season in a given area. An event that is often reported in the news and marks the arrival of winter.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}、{初雪|はつゆき}が{降|ふ}った。
examples.english: The first snow of the season fell this morning.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}で{初雪|はつゆき}が{観測|かんそく}された。
examples.english: The first snow of the season was observed in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{初雪|はつゆき}は{例年|れいねん}より{遅|おそ}く、12{月|がつ}に{入|はい}ってからだった。
examples.english: This year's first snow came later than usual, not until December.

notes:
Part of a group of seasonal "first" words using {初|はつ}:
・{初日|はつひ}の{出|で} (first sunrise of the new year)
・{初夢|はつゆめ} (first dream of the new year)
・{初霜|はつしも} (first frost of the season)

The first snow is announced officially by local meteorological observatories and is often treated as a seasonal news event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{初雪|はつゆき}が{降|ふ}る (the first snow falls)
・{初雪|はつゆき}を{観測|かんそく}する (observe the first snow)
・{初雪|はつゆき}が{早|はや}い / {遅|おそ}い (the first snow is early / late)
